units.source_text: 1. [\[16\]](../Text/chapter15.xhtml#fnref16) 从立春起第二日一十天，

en.t: 1. [[16]] The two hundred and tenth day counted from the beginning of spring,

units.source_text: 在九月一日前后，这一天常刮台风，农家把它看作灾难之日。​

en.t: falls around September first; typhoons often blow on this day, and farming families regard it as a day of disaster.
